name: Circumcerebral 20 ms CCW (theta study)
summary: Counter-clockwise rotation, 20 ms per coil (one revolution = 160 ms, about 6 Hz). Richards, Koren & Persinger 2002 reported ~30 % more theta power with 20 ms rates of change; Booth 2008: CCW raised right-hemisphere power.
source: Richards, Koren & Persinger 2002, Percept Mot Skills 95:671 (PMID 12434867) ; Booth et al. 2008
